task:
user inputs:
coefs of fourier basis of fns f: S^1 -> R satisfying f(θ+pi) = -f(θ)
t \in [0,1]

for every {x,y} in the plane, convert to polar {r,θ}, then update to {r+t*f(θ),θ} & convert back to cartesian. do this for a whole canvas to visualize w/ a checkerboard domain coloring
